verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Supabase Auth controls session lifetime, refresh tokens, and multi-device sign-in behavior. No evidence shows users or admins can list active sessions or devices, or revoke them individually or all at once. Session-lifetime configuration is an adjacent control, not the requested session-visibility and revocation capability.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can let users and admins see active sessions and devices and revoke them individually or all at once

citations.quote: Control session lifetime, refresh tokens, and multi-device sign-in behavior.
